title: Registry: backup restore round-trip (registry_restore_verify)
description: Runs `nexus backup restore registry registry --yes`. Reloads the node-local dump into a throwaway registry_restore_verify DB and counts the restored tables — the non-destructive integrity round-trip — then drops the verify DB.

observe.what: GREEN backup restore registry — items restored = the same N tables taken (loaded into registry_restore_verify, counted, dropped)

whatProves: RegistryAdapter.BackupRestoreAsync reloads the gzip dump into a verify DB, counts the public tables, and drops it — the take/restore round-trip proof (blobs stay in MinIO; live data untouched).
